test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Monica and Chandler are siblings. Chandler is the nephew of Grace and the father of Maria. Kathy is the sister of Grace. Phoebe is the mother of Kathy. How is Monica related to Phoebe?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Monica and Chandler are siblings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13fb27504b819158cc5548298a0aabb0f39c62c62b016b95668ed753ebd63b9f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59688d7c220137990187efbcc8c2a5cc4b3e82bfd304d302dc121ca51b914cef.png] 

2) Chandler is the nephew of Grace and the father of Maria.

3) Kathy is the sister of Grace.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89d68d74870ef9cbd94b231db7f7fbcf370fa9c572d749cea1258301738af884.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8c67da03c5ad862ec707ec59be09a9d61e200eda188c97cdf6ab11904558df7.png] 

4) Phoebe is the mother of Kathy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b12889c9b5de28db7b859f9991d495d00706fa4b3112abea29592f413c1efa20.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/962293fc746c303b4f3f75924d6dd525e3a2956d44733427497245583be8e5f9.png] 

So, Monica is Phoebe's either granddaughter or grandson.

As out of all the options, granddaughter is given, therefore Monica is Phoebe's granddaughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
